name: Solomon Islands
summary: The Wills, Probate and Administration Act (Cap. 33) applies to ordinary property, not to customary land, which passes by custom. No fixed heirship share or family provision was found. Trust and foundation law and Hague status are not confirmed.
family_claims: Not found; the Act does not govern customary land or matters regulated by current customary usage (s 2).
foreign_law_note: No conflict-of-law rule sourced. Perpetual estates pass on intestacy by current custom as certified by the local court (s 105).
trust_note: Received UK trustee law is reported to apply; no local trust statute was sourced, so 'limited' is recorded. No foundation law found.
open_questions: The HCCH table as retrieved shows no entry for this jurisdiction (the retrieved copy was marked last updated 2017 and its territorial-extension notes could not be read); re-check the live table.
Trust/foundation availability marked unclear: no statute was found, which does not show that none exists.
